Daylight Hours Calculator

Compute sunrise, sunset and day length for any date and latitude using standard solar equations — no location lookup needed.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a date and enter your latitude (-90 to 90).
  2. Optionally add longitude and your UTC offset for clock times.
  3. Press Calculate.
  4. Read sunrise, sunset, solar noon and total day length.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How accurate is this?

It uses the standard astronomical formulas: solar declination, the equation of time and the sunrise hour angle with a 90.833° zenith (accounts for refraction).

Does it handle polar day and night?

Yes — enter values beyond ±66.5° in summer/winter and it correctly reports polar day (24h daylight) or polar night (0h).

How do I get clock times instead of just day length?

Add your longitude and UTC offset to convert solar times into local clock times.
